guard.undefined: NOT_INTERPRETABLE iff an MSE is not finite and positive

rules.deviation: picks that differ from the design's expected picks write nothing and stop for review; no reserve is ever substituted
rules.exclusion: its id was never used as a cue by Experiments 005–023: 023's exclusion (b0c.exclusion, reproduced from the frozen inputs) plus 023's own cues and its frames' cue ids
rules.frame_tokens: its id occurs nowhere in the 108 exposed frames (their prefix and suffix tokens): the lesson of 023's ' shiny'
rules.lemmas: a measure or ordinary lemma counts only when both its singular and its plural are eligible (and distinct)
rules.picks: the first class-quota eligible entries of each ordered list, mechanically; B and C are the plurals, D and E the singulars of the picked lemmas
rules.score: the nounness score is never computed at the freeze and never selects, rejects, reorders or classifies a candidate
rules.target_nouns: its id is none of the token ids of any target noun's singular or plural forms (every piece of every pool noun's forms, as the design-time inventory counted them: 161 ids)
rules.word: ' ' + w is a single token of the pinned tokenizer
